title: Figure 1: Schematic diagram of friction stir welding (FSW)
description: Line-drawn schematic of two plates being joined by a rotating cylindrical tool, with labels "tool rotation", "Tool velocity", "advancing side" and "retreating side" along the weld seam. Caption: "Figure 1. Schematic Diagram of Friction Stir Welding." The text explains FSW for joining high-strength Al alloys such as 7050, including use on the space shuttle external tank.
